market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: Oil at $40 represents a ~40% drop from current levels over ~15 months. Given CL's annualized volatility of ~35% and historical frequency of such drawdowns (e.g. 2015-16, 2020), the true probability is roughly 5%, far above the market's implied 1.1%. The market appears to significantly underpice this tail risk.
evidence_points: WTI CL front-month currently near $66; $40 is a -39% move.
1.25-year standard deviation of log return ~0.39, with a z-score of -1.28; barrier hit probability higher than delta.
Historical episodes: oil traded below $40 during 2015-16 and briefly in 2020, implying base rates above 1%.
Current macro uncertainty (tariffs, OPEC+ unwinding cuts) adds downside risk.
